column1: # Arabic (ar) catalog for Mansa (Mansa), the Creative Studio launcher.
# Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other (English) or one|other (Arabic; a dual and the
#   few/many forms are not separate here, so 2 and 3-10 use the 'other' form).
# Written from the meaning of the English text. The product name is Mansa; "Creative Studio"
# stays in Latin letters, like the other Creative Studio apps.
